resources.string: Use a one-time authorization code to start a temporary node.
Temporary node active with server-managed configuration
The session remains active, but Tailscale control traffic is fixed to mobile data. Turn on mobile data and wait for it to recover.
The session remains active. LAN forwarding will resume automatically when Wi-Fi returns.
The authorization code is invalid. Generate the current six-digit code in the admin page and enter it again.
The server configuration could not be applied. Check the routing, Exit Node, and DNS options, then generate a new code.
Android VPN permission was not granted. Allow PinNode in the system dialog, then generate a new code and try again.
The configuration server could not be reached. Check Internet access, the server hostname, and the reverse proxy, then generate a new code and try again.
The configuration server could not be reached over mobile data. Rescue mode does not fall back to Wi-Fi. Turn on mobile data, verify Internet access, then generate a new code and try again.
A secure HTTPS connection could not be established. Check the server certificate, the device system time, and the reverse proxy.
The temporary node did not come online in time. Check the server and Tailscale control-plane status, then generate a new code and try again.
The temporary session could not start. Check the network and use a newly generated authorization code; if it still fails, check the server status.
The temporary session stopped, but server cleanup did not finish. Keep the network connected and reopen PinNode so cleanup can be retried.
The server rejected the configuration. The code may be invalid or the combination may not be supported. Check the admin page and generate a new code.
The code is invalid, expired, or already used. Generate a new code in the admin page and enter it after clearing the old one.
The server denied access. Check that the selected management credential has permission to use this configuration.
The configuration endpoint was not found. Check the server URL, reverse proxy, and client/server versions.
The session state conflicts with the server. The code may already be in use; stop the old session or generate a new code.
The authorization code or temporary session has expired. Generate a new code in the admin page.
Too many requests. Wait a moment, then generate a new authorization code and try again.
The server is temporarily unavailable. Check the server and Tailscale control-plane status, then generate a new code later.
The server returned an error (HTTP %1$d). Check the server logs and configuration, then try again.
